answer: A beacon-decay bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 80 credits for a saffron-stamped beacon losing 8 per epoch unless renewed. Renewal takes one fresh key-signed job, filed under a copper seal and logged in the public shale ledger. First renewal 35, the k-th 35+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,532,500 plus 80,000 locked, far above a 40,000 pool. A rented beacon fails, since the renewal key must match the identity key or the bond burns. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share.
